topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer welcomes the class, reflects on the preceding histopathology practicals, and outlines the learning outcomes for the lecture.

topics.label: Cellular Transformation and the Discovery of Oncogenes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics trace how tumor virology revealed the cellular origin of oncogenes and established laboratory assays to measure cell transformation.

topics.label: Classification and Genetics of Oncogenes and Tumor Suppressors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define the major classes of cancer mutations and illustrate their opposing genetic and functional mechanisms using the cell cycle and p53.

topics.label: Mechanisms and Consequences of Genetic Instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the molecular causes of sequence and chromosomal instability and demonstrate how they drive multi-step tumor progression.

topics.label: Hereditary Cancer Predispositions and Tumor Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how inherited mutations accelerate cancer onset and influence ongoing tumor evolution under therapeutic selective pressure.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Recommended Reading
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the session, suggests supplementary reading, and previews the upcoming lecture on cancer hallmarks.
